correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 17-perfect-matching enumeration, complete 761-face acyclic discrete-Morse matching with exactly one critical vertex and six critical triangles, and 2610 checked incidences. This proves an integral six-2-sphere wedge; 48 exact signed Lefschetz traces yield the character and zero invariants. Independent brute-force subset enumeration and mod-two chain calculation corroborate the face and homology counts.

value.rationale: Complete integral topology of a canonical nonplanar vertex-transitive cubic bipartite graph, together with a nontrivial full automorphism action: despite six independent two-dimensional homology classes, no rational class is globally fixed. The comparison with the known ordinary matching complex isolates a genuine extendibility-topology change. The exact graph/invariant combination is intrinsically motivated; no broad generalization is asserted.
